_doc: Rules for the PZO crash diagnoser. The Java engine (Diagnoser.java) and the Discord bot's /diagnose read this same file, so a verdict is the same wherever it is worked out.

Inputs: 'console' = the last 4 MB of console.txt, 'engine' = pzo_engine.log of the crashed session (pzo_engine.prev.log when read at the next launch), 'hs_err' = each hs_err_pid*.log, only the lines above the first '---------------  P R O C E S S' header (the crashing thread).

A rule is tried against every line of each input in 'files'. 'pattern' is a regex that must work in both Java and Python (search, not full match). 'flags': 'i' = ignore case. 'tail_lines' limits console/engine to their last N lines.

'mod_group' is the capture group holding a mod's name. 'kind': 'rewritten_frame' has no pattern: it matches a stack frame (class.method followed by an opening bracket) whose class.method is listed on a '[PZO Rewrites] class: method, method' line of 'engine'.
The verdict is the matched rule with the highest 'priority'; for that rule the last matching line is the evidence. Other matched rules are listed as 'also seen'. No match = verdict 'unknown'.
'text': true marks a rule the Discord bot also tries against the text of a message posted in a support ticket, for errors people paste instead of sending a report. The engine ignores it.
Verdicts: pzo, pzo_possible, mod, install, user, unknown.

rules.title: The crash happened inside PZO's native library
rules.advice: This is a PZO bug. Please send the report file.

rules.title: PZO code was running on the thread that crashed
rules.advice: This is most likely a PZO bug. Please send the report file.

rules.title: An error near the end of the log came from PZO code
rules.advice: This is most likely a PZO bug. Please send the report file.

rules.title: The crash happened inside the graphics driver
rules.advice: Update the graphics driver, or reinstall it cleanly. If it only crashes with PZO installed, send the report file as well.

rules.pattern: java\.lang\.OutOfMemoryError|Out of Memory Error|insufficient memory for the Java Runtime
rules.title: The game ran out of memory
rules.advice: Give the game more memory (the -Xmx value in ProjectZomboid64.json), close other programs, or run fewer or lighter mods.

rules.title: The game could not load its sound files
rules.advice: A game file is damaged or from another version. In Steam: right click Project Zomboid, Properties, Installed Files, Verify integrity of game files.

rules.title: PZO's native library could not be loaded
rules.advice: The PZO install is incomplete or was blocked by security software. Run the PZO installer again.

rules.title: The error went through a game method that PZO changes
rules.advice: PZO may be involved. Please send the report file so it can be checked.

rules.title: A game class did not match what the code using it expected
rules.advice: This comes from PZO or a Java mod changing game code, or from a game update that PZO or a mod has not caught up with yet. Check for a PZO update and send the report file.

rules.pattern: pzopt-classes was built for game revision
rules.title: The PZ_Optimization mod (pzopt) does not match this game version. That message is from pzopt, not PZO
rules.advice: PZ_Optimization is a different mod from PZO and PZO cannot fix it. Turn PZ_Optimization off or get its build for your game version from its own page, and report it to that mod's author.

rules.title: The crash happened inside one of the game's own native libraries
rules.advice: Verify the game files in Steam first. If it keeps happening, send the report file.

rules.title: A mod's Lua code was throwing errors
rules.advice: Turn that mod off and try again. If the crash stops, report it to the mod's author.

rules.title: The last errors in the log point at a mod's files
rules.advice: Turn that mod off and try again. If the crash stops, report it to the mod's author.

rules.title: A thread died with an error nobody handled
rules.advice: The report file has the details. Send it if you want it looked at.

rules.title: The Java runtime itself crashed
rules.advice: The report file has the crash log. Send it if you want it looked at.
